message: Hi, my kid Dean is 8 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for Dean's age group.
They're structured and age-appropriate, and it's a great environment for kids to learn. Is Dean interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, he would love to try a free trial class! What time do you have available?
Awesome! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
My name is Tester Fjord.
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.fjord@gmail.com.
Perfect! And is this number I can reach you at if needed?
Yes, you can reach me at 860-555-0605.

Great, got it! And what's Dsan's full name?
*Dean's
Dean Fjord.
Perfect! And what's Dean's date of birth? This helps us make sure he's in the right age group.
Dean's birthday is May 16, 2018.
Perfect! Dean is 8, so he'll be in our kids program. Let me check what times we have available for his free trial and I'll get right back to you!
Sounds good! Thank you!
You're welcome! I'm checking on available times now and will have some options for you shortly.
Thanks! I appreciate it.
Of course! I'm working on it now. Should have some trial class times for Dean in just a moment.
Great, I'll be here!

I'm so sorry for the delay! It looks like our online booking system isn't loading right now. Let me have one of our instructors reach out to you directly at 860-555-0605 to get Dean scheduled for his free trial. They'll be in touch soon!
No problem at all! Thank you for your help. I'll keep an eye out for their call.
Perfect! They'll be reaching out soon. Dean is going to love it here. Talk soon!
Looking forward to it! Talk soon!
Thanks Tester! Have a great night!
You too! Have a great night!
Thanks! 😊
You're welcome! 😊
Take care!
